units.reason: New test only; it adds coverage for unsorted, duplicate refs and cannot affect production behavior.
units.headline: New test: CompactSelectedSeries handles unsorted and duplicate refs
units.summary: Appends three series, calls CompactSelectedSeries with refs that are reversed and duplicated, and asserts the call succeeds, the head ends empty and only one block is written. It is test-only, and its claims hold: the input [s3,s1,s2,...] really is unsorted, and all samples fall inside one 1000ms chunk range.

units.reason: Exported type StaleHead is renamed, which removes it from the public tsdb package API that downstream libraries import.
units.headline: StaleHead renamed to SelectedSeriesHead with generic seriesRefs field
units.summary: The exported compaction-only head view StaleHead becomes SelectedSeriesHead, and its field now uses the renamed seriesRefs type. The type is now shared by stale-series compaction and the new CompactSelectedSeries path. Its fields are unexported and not serialized, but the exported name StaleHead disappears.
focus: Whether downstream consumers of the tsdb package (Mimir, Thanos) reference StaleHead or NewStaleHead and will break on upgrade

units.reason: Exported constructor NewStaleHead is removed and replaced, a public API change for library consumers.
units.headline: NewStaleHead replaced by NewSelectedSeriesHead constructor
units.summary: The constructor is renamed and takes the renamed seriesRefs type; its body is the same field assignment as before. In this PR both CompactStaleHead and CompactSelectedSeries call it through compactHeadViewLocked.
focus: External callers of NewStaleHead, and the fact that its parameter type is unexported, so outside packages cannot build one anyway

units.reason: Pure delegation, renamed to call the renamed selectedSeriesIndex helper with the same arguments.
units.headline: Index now delegates to head.selectedSeriesIndex
units.summary: The method now forwards mint, maxt and the selected refs to selectedSeriesIndex instead of staleIndex. Any behavior change lives in that helper, which is reviewed as its own unit.

units.reason: Return value changes from the head-wide stale count to the number of refs in the view, which feeds Meta().Stats.
units.headline: NumSeries now counts selected refs instead of head stale count
units.summary: It used to return head.NumStaleSeries(), a global counter. It now returns len(selectedSeriesRefs.sortedByRef), which is right for arbitrary selections and for stale selections that exclude series with out-of-order data. The value reaches BlockMeta.Stats.NumSeries through Meta().
focus: Any consumer of the view's Meta().Stats.NumSeries during compaction (sizing, logging) that relied on the old global stale count

units.reason: Placeholder ULID for an in-memory compaction view is renamed and given a new constant; the value is non-strict parsed like the old one.
units.headline: Placeholder ULID renamed to selectedSeriesHeadULID with new value
units.summary: The fake ULID that identifies the head view changes from STALEHEAD to SELECTEDSERIES text. The string is 26 characters and is parsed by non-strict MustParse, just as the old one was (which also held a non-Crockford L), so it does not panic. It is only used as the view's Meta ULID.

units.reason: Receiver renamed and placeholder ULID constant swapped; structure is otherwise unchanged.
units.headline: Meta uses renamed receiver and selectedSeriesHeadULID
units.summary: The method returns the same BlockMeta shape as before, with the new placeholder ULID. NumSeries now comes from the changed NumSeries method, which is reviewed separately.

units.reason: Only the receiver name and the human-readable string used in logs and errors change.
units.headline: String output now reads 'selected-series head'
units.summary: The receiver is renamed, the doc typo is fixed, and the text changes from 'stale head' to 'selected-series head'. The only effect is on log and error text.
